snippet.title: Pass and Play Games: Free Board Games for 2+ Players on One Phone
snippet.description:
One phone, two players, game on. Pass and Play Games is a free site of classic board games you play together on one phone, tablet or computer. Take your turn and pass the device, or play the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard.

Play free: https://passandplaygames.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=meet-pass-and-play

In this video:
0:05 Free, on one phone, tablet or computer
0:10 Pick a game and add your names
0:13 Take turns and pass the device
0:19 Play the computer: Easy, Medium or Hard
0:24 Chess, Ludo, Checkers, Snakes and Ladders, Four in a Row, Mancala
0:29 All 14 games
0:34 No sign-up, works offline

Collections:

Dice Games: https://passandplaygames.com/dice-games?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=meet-pass-and-play
Games vs Computer: https://passandplaygames.com/games-vs-computer?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=meet-pass-and-play
Offline Games: https://passandplaygames.com/offline-games?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=meet-pass-and-play

Pass and Play Games: free board games for two or more people on one phone, tablet or computer. No sign-up, and every game works offline after your first visit.
